sources.title: Jupiter rate limits
sources.facts: Documentation describes per-organisation sliding-window limits and shared main request bucket; quota and 429 handling must be versioned.
sources.implementation_implication: Do not multiply provider budget by parallel workers/API keys. Runtime uses configured plan/response policy; recheck before actual acquisition.

sources.title: Solana fee structure
sources.facts: The documentation separates base and prioritisation fees and states fees are charged on failed included transactions.
sources.implementation_implication: Account for failure costs. Pin transaction format and correct fee calculation; avoid one generic formula across formats.
